links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting of the LLMs for new vertebral fracture prediction
links.outcome: New vertebral fracture (NVF) prediction after PKP
links.effect: Zero-shot LLM performance was poor (F1-score 0.309; MCC 0.044) but improved with few-shot learning; post-few-shot numbers not given in the abstract
links.quote: For NVF prediction, the zero-shot LLM performance was poor (F1-score, 0.309; MCC, 0.044) but improved with few-shot learning.

links.comparator_used: Spine surgeons predicting complications without exposure to LLM responses
links.outcome: Surgeon prediction performance for BCL and NVF
links.effect: LLM explanations improved surgeon performance for BCL but not for NVF; surgeons alone had BCL F1-score 0.675-0.684, MCC 0.074-0.185; numeric values with LLM exposure not given in the abstract
links.quote: LLM explanations enhanced surgeon performance in BCL prediction but not in NVF.
